transcription_notes: HI-RES RE-IMAGE of Witness CAM = Cambridge University Library MS Add. 1570 (Ethiopic OT, 1588-89 CE), folio 106r, file MS-ADD-01570_f106r_1Sam1_hires.jpg, 7760x10328 px losslessly tile-stitched IIIF master. This is the high-resolution re-imaging of the same CAM witness previously transcribed at lower resolution (independent fresh read; the prior low-res CAM JSON and the GG witness were NOT consulted). HAND: a regular, upright Ethiopic gwilh/book hand, 3 columns per page, dense, with extensive red rubrication of clause-initial words and divine names (this heavy rubrication of running text — NOT a heading — is normal for this MS). LAYOUT/GEOMETRY (verified from the image): text block roughly y 1500-8050; column 1 x ~560-2900, column 2 x ~2900-5240, column 3 x ~5180-7350, with blank gutters. The top ~7 lines of COLUMN 1 ONLY carry the multi-line red+black rubricated book-incipit/argumentum ('በስመ፡እግዚእ፡ብሔር፡መሐሪ… መጽሐፈ፡ነገሥተ፡እስራኤል፡ወይሁዳ… እስከ፡ኪይቅያስ፡ወልደ፡ኢዮስያስ…') ending with a red 'ክፍል ፩ ።።' Section-1 marker; this incipit is NOT verse text and is EXCLUDED. Columns 2 and 3 have NO separate heading — they are pure continuation of the running narrative (their heavily-rubricated tops are running text, not a heading). CH.1 EXTENT: the black running narrative of 1 Sam 1 begins in col.1 at line ~8 ('ወሀሎ ፩ ብእሲ፡እምነ፡አርማቴም…' = Elkanah of Ramathaim), runs to the bottom of col.1 (~y8000), continues through ALL of col.2, and into the TOP of col.3 (lines 1-~8); it ENDS at a red 'ክፍል ፫ ።።' Section-3 marker on col.3 (after '…ለእግዚአብሔር'). CH.1->CH.2 BOUNDARY: immediately after that red 'ክፍል ፫' marker, on the next line of col.3, chapter 2 (Hannah's Song) begins 'ጸንዓ፡ልብየ፡በእግዚአብ[ሔር]…' ('My heart is strengthened in the LORD'); a faint modern pencil 'ምዕ ፪' margin note confirms the ch.2 start. Transcription STOPS at that boundary; Hannah's Song is excluded. SEGMENTATION: the MS has NO numbered verses; verses were segmented by the red cross-shaped rubric dividers (rendered ☩ in this note, stripped from tokens) plus narrative sense, and numbered contiguously 1..28. The contiguous count of 28 is a best segmentation, not forced from memory; a few divider placements are soft (esp. vv.5/6, 13/14, 17/18, 24/25 where rubric and sense boundaries do not perfectly coincide) — see per-verse uncertain[] notes. Two internal red 'ክፍል' Section markers fall inside ch.1: 'ክፍል ፩' ends the incipit before v.1; 'ክፍል ፪' appears mid-chapter at the end of v.20 / before v.21 (col.2); 'ክፍል ፫' ends ch.1 in col.3. These ክፍል+numeral markers are rubric and are stripped from tokens (noted in uncertain[] where they affect a verse boundary). NUMERAL RULE: every Ethiopic numeral glyph (e.g. the ፩ in v.1 'ወሀሎ ፩ ብእሲ', and the ፩/፪/፫ in the ክፍል section markers) is treated as its OWN standalone token in linear position, never glued to adjacent letters; the 'geez' verbatim string may keep numerals adjacent to surrounding text, but 'tokens' always separates each numeral as a discrete token. LEGIBILITY: this hi-res master is of excellent, diacritic-level fidelity — vowel-order diacritics (e.g. ቡ/በ/ቢ/ባ, ሁ/ህ/ሂ/ሃ, ዐ/ዓ) are individually resolvable across nearly the entire chapter, decisively better than a low-res crop would permit; genuine illegibility is effectively absent (no ⟦illegible⟧ sentinels were needed). The uncertain[] flags are therefore almost all LEXICAL/orthographic ambiguities (rare or contracted spellings, words split across a rubric break or a column break, faint modern pencil catchwords overlapping a line, and two small light parchment-soiling stains over parts of col.2 vv.6 and 23) — they are NOT cases of physically unreadable glyphs. Per-witness orthographic peculiarities of this MS noted: heavy clause-initial rubrication; frequent contracted/variant spellings (e.g. የቅም for የቀውም); occasional doubled connective ወይቤላ; transliterated loanwords (ኢፋ 'ephah', ጶመስፈርት 'bottle'). Marginalia and small interlinear glosses in the left/right margins and a faint modern pencil foliation ('106') and chapter pencil-notes are out of scope and excluded.
